reviews.review:
Alright, here we go. I've played a good chunk of the game and here's my personal review. Flee The Fallen is a 2D side scrolling action platformer with some survival horror elements like item management and light environmental puzzle mixed in. It takes some inspirtation from the likes of Resident Evil 4 and goes full 2D.

Pros-
1) Good art style that draws a lot of inspiration from 90s anime. The cutscenes which are sometimes animated are decently made.
2) The combat is pretty solid. Everything from the shooting to kicking enemies when they're stunned to finish them off is handled quite well. Helps to conserve ammo when you're low on it.
3) There's a very healthy amount of enemy variety . New enemies are constantly introduced as you progress in the game. It helps to keep things somewhat interesting even though the core gameplay might get quite repitive after a while.
4) Decent arsenal of weapons. You keep finding new weapons both meele and ranged as you progress and there's a good variety of them with varying damage dealt to the undead.
5) It gets better. The game starts slow with just a measly pistol and a knife but as you progress it gets better.

Needs Improvement-
1) A game like this needs more blood and gore. It's quite limited as of now,
2) Lack of enough verticality and limited exploration. While there's definitely some verticality and some rewards to find as you explore the levels which are mostly linear but with some short branching paths, a game like this needs to be a little more complex to be more interesting.
3) Add more flying enemies and the ability to aim upwards to make the combat more engaging. Allow the player to shoot and swing while jumping as well.
4) The platforming can be janky as the protagonist can get stuck trying to grab a ledge sometimes (can be easily fixed through patches)
5) The first levels of the game are slow compared to the later levels where there's more platforming and tougher enemies are introduced. The pacing can be better.

To summarize, there's definitely some effort made here and while it might not be a metroidvania or go toe to toe with giants like resident evil. It's a very simple and servicible action platformer game that definitely has some charm to it. Nothing's broken here. For the asking price, it's a good enough experience.
